comparison.objective: Insert and latch a detached wrist camera into its mount; candidate removes open cartons from a conveyor.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1289 tests tapered-channel alignment, guided insertion, spring-tooth latching and release after installation. Candidate tests moving sidewall grasping around flaps and transport of loose contents.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1289 requires optical pose within 5 mm/5 degrees, verified seating/latch engagement, live frame delivery and 2 s released retention. Candidate requires belt clearance, content retention, tray placement, 60 mm release clearance and 3 s stability.
comparison.reason: Precision insertion and functional latch verification are meaningfully different from selective conveyor removal.
